$comment: Local recognisers. Runtime source and model revisions are pinned independently because the model repositories do not contain Marvi's LiveKit adapter. Measured on 2 September 2026 against docs/evals/stt-candidates: parakeet-tdt leads on accuracy and throughput, nemotron leads on responsiveness by 1.8 seconds, and kyutai-1b loses both while being the only one that can end a turn on meaning rather than on a timer.

engines.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B
engines.description: Most accurate and the fastest to finish. Waits about three seconds before its first partial.

engines.name: Nemotron 3.5 Streaming 0.6B
engines.description: First words about 1.8 seconds sooner, for roughly four points more word error.

engines.name: Kyutai STT 1B
engines.description: Knows when you have finished talking, from what you said rather than from silence. Least accurate of the three and needs most of the card.
